X,Z are offsets of about 40 m from AOWiki landmarks (Tir grid 542x536, Rome Red grid 250x320, Rome Blue shops around 620x340, Rome Green between the GMI and the Jobe whompah, Borealis between the grid and the whompas). Walk them with /pos and edit this file; the next .invasion start re-reads it. Waves reuse the crashed-ship hashes. Trash counts grow with players inside Radius; bosses and towers stay Fixed.
